name: Oceane Lamb
source:
Oceane Lamb is the only daughter of Augustus Lamb, the infamous Industrialist. The Lambs used to reside at the Mid-Levels, but after the King rescinded his support for industrialization, the Lambs resettled at the Northern Peninsula, and became one of the richest families in the city.

Oceane is a smart and meticulous hardworker. Despite her privileged background, she frequents the East End in search of local delicacies and mechanical parts for her robot.
